goals.title: Operate as a safe, budget-aware AI team
goals.description: Select useful roadmap work without a new daily prompt while preserving human approval gates.

roadmap_items.title: Validate the autonomous daily-run configuration
roadmap_items.description: Inspect the configured schedule, permission ceiling, and dry-run controls and produce a concise validation note.
acceptance_criteria: The configured schedule, timezone, and dry-run setting are reported.
No credentials or secret values appear in the output.
No external or destructive action is performed.

roadmap_items.title: Propose the first production smoke-test checklist
roadmap_items.description: Draft a reviewable checklist for validating one scheduled dry run on Railway and one Telegram summary.
acceptance_criteria: The checklist distinguishes local verification from live Railway and Telegram checks.
The checklist includes overlap prevention, idempotency, redaction, and budget reporting.
The output is a proposal only and starts no deployment.
